newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian Electro Cables 95/6 profits up.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian Electro Cables 95/6 profits up.

text.p: Egyptian Electro Cables slightly raised net distributable profits for financial 1995/6 to 36.58 million pounds ($10.76 million) from 36.50 million in the previous year, results published on Thursday showed.
The financial year ends on June 30.

Shareholders are entitled to 27.5 million pounds of that profit, compared to 25.2 million in 1994/5. The 1995/6 profit figure would mean an 8.3 pound dividend for each of the partly private firm's 3.3 million shares.
The firm also increased sales in 1995/6 to 361.3 million from 332.7 million in 1994/5.

Investors and financial institutions own 20.01 percent of Egyptian Electro Cables and shares trade regularly on the Cairo stock exchange. The company's workers own 9.99 percent and the official Holding Company for Engineering Industries owns the remaining 70 percent stake.
The state said earlier this year it would auction the holding company's share to a strategic investor.
Egyptian Electro Cables manufactures electric and telephone wires for export and domestic use.
